maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The three distinct spots in the uppermost row are positioned approximately two spot-diameters dorsal to the primary row, following a parallel arc along the maxillary contour.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Estimated 95% melanin saturation with dominant dark/black pixel distribution across the visible apex of the nose.
